place.name: Hamina
place.description: Hamina (Finnish pronunciation: [ˈhɑminɑ]; Swedish: Fredrikshamn, Finland Swedish: [freːdriksˈhɑmn] , Sweden Swedish: [freːdrɪksˈhamːn]) is a town and a municipality of Southern Finland on the coast of the gulf of Finland, first mentioned in 1336. Hamina has one of the most important harbors of Finland, the Port of Hamina-Kotka.
